data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

edge_embedded.name: servo
edge_embedded.summary: Servo是一个基于Rust编写的实验性浏览器引擎，旨在为嵌入式网页内容提供高性能渲染方案。其核心利用Rust的内存安全与并行处理能力，通过细粒度任务隔离实现快速安全的渲染。开发者可将Servo作为模块化组件集成到桌面或移动应用中，构建定制浏览器功能，或通过研究其设计学习现代系统编程对网页技术栈的优化。该项目展示了用安全系统语言重构浏览器核心的路径，为嵌入式网页渲染需求提供了灵活技术基础。
edge_embedded.summary_en: Servo is an experimental web browser engine written in Rust that provides a high-performance alternative for embedding web content in applications. Its key innovation is using Rust's memory safety and parallelism to process web pages with exceptional speed and security through fine-grained task isolation. Developers can integrate Servo as a rendering component in desktop or mobile apps, experiment with its modular architecture to build custom browser features, or study its implementation to learn modern systems programming techniques for web technologies.

ui_devex.name: markitdown
ui_devex.summary: Markitdown 是一个 Python 工具，能够将 PDF 和 Office 文档等多种文件格式转换为清晰的 Markdown 文本，解决了从专有格式中提取结构化内容的难题。它通过 AI 模型智能解析文档布局，在转换过程中保留标题、列表等关键格式元素，确保输出内容的可读性和可用性。你可以将其集成到文档处理流程中，用于转换研究报告进行文本分析，或扩展自定义解析器来处理特定类型的专业文档，非常适合需要批量处理办公文档的开发者和研究人员。
ui_devex.summary_en: Markitdown is a Python tool that converts various file formats like PDFs and Office documents into clean Markdown, solving the problem of extracting structured text from proprietary formats for easier editing and processing. It leverages AI models to intelligently parse document layouts and preserve formatting elements like headings and lists during conversion. You can integrate it into document processing pipelines, use it to convert research papers for analysis, or extend it with custom parsers for specialized document types.

security_safety.name: RuView
security_safety.summary: RuView 是一个基于 Rust 的开源项目，通过普通 WiFi 信号实现实时人体姿态估计和生命体征监测，无需摄像头，解决了监控和医疗场景中的隐私问题。其核心技术在于利用 WiFi 信道状态信息（CSI），捕捉人体运动和呼吸引起的细微信号变化，通过信号处理和机器学习算法重建姿态与生理数据。开发者可将它集成到智能家居系统中进行存在检测，尝试用于老年人跌倒监测，或基于现有算法扩展新的感知应用，仅需常规 WiFi 硬件即可实验。
security_safety.summary_en: RuView is an open-source Rust project that transforms ordinary WiFi signals into real-time human pose estimation and vital sign monitoring without cameras, addressing privacy concerns in surveillance and healthcare. It leverages WiFi's Channel State Information (CSI) to detect subtle signal variations caused by human movement and breathing, using signal processing and machine learning to reconstruct pose and physiological data. Developers can integrate it into smart home systems for presence detection, experiment with fall detection for elderly care, or extend its algorithms to new sensing applications using commodity WiFi hardware.
